target.title: Drop redundant escaping in redirect
target.description: The location is already URL-encoded with iri_to_uri when the Location header is set, so escaping it again for the HTML body is redundant.

Title: Drop redundant escaping in redirect

Description:
The location is already URL-encoded with iri_to_uri when the Location header is set, so escaping it again for the HTML body is redundant.
